data.name: Gunasekar
data.gender_notes: Gunasekar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Guna means 'knowledge' or 'power' and Sekar means 'skill' or 'power'. The name Gunasekar thus signifies a person who possesses great knowledge and skill. In Hindu mythology, Gunasekar is the name of various gods and goddesses associated with wisdom, knowledge, and power. The name Gunasekar carries the meaning “Knowledge, Power, Skill” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gunasekar usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, power, skill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, and the application of that knowledge in the service of others.
data.etymology: Gunasekar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Power, Skill.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gunasekar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gunasekar has been a popular choice amongst the Hindu community in India and beyond, reflecting the deep reverence and value placed upon knowledge and skills. In Hindu society, learning and mastering various forms of art, literature, science, and philosophy have traditionally been highly regarded and often linked to the pursuit of personal growth and self-realization. Gunasekar, as a name that embodies these primary qualities, can be seen as a reminder of the importance of acquiring knowledge and honing one's skills in both secular and spiritual aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Gunasekar stems from the deeper meaning associated with the words 'knowledge' (Guna) and 'skill' (Sekar'). In Hindu philosophy, knowledge and skill are considered essential components for spiritual growth and ultimately, self-realization or union with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Gunasekar in Sanskrit translates to one who upholds or embodies the virtues or good qualities (Guna) of dharma (righteousness), artha (prosperity), kama (desire), and moksha (liberation). This name is a constant reminder for the individual to nurture and uphold these virtues in all aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Gunasekar was a renowned scholar during the medieval Chola period. The name Gunasekar carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Gunasekar was a scholar during the Chola dynasty, which ruled the southern Indian subcontinent from the 9th to the 13th centuries.
